sources: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/krul-campground-blackwater-river-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120113 (campground page, all 43 site rows and each site's campsiteDetails page, read 2026-10-21)

hookups.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/krul-campground-blackwater-river-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120113 (every one of the 43 sites: Electricity Hookup 30/50, Water Hookup Y; 'Krul Lake campground has electric sites available for recreational vehicles or tents'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 43 site-specific RV-or-tent sites; listed max vehicle lengths run 29 to 90 ft (most 32-51; two pull-throughs at 68 and 90 ft, two back-ins at 73). The booking site says the tow vehicle counts in the unit length and the rig must fit entirely in the site.

sites.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/krul-campground-blackwater-river-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120113 ('43 site(s) found'; each site's Max Vehicle Length and Access Type; 'Vehicles pulling a camper must be included in the total length of the unit when selecting sites'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.fdacs.gov/Forest-Wildfire/Our-Forests/State-Forests/Blackwater-River-State-Forest/Recreation-Areas-at-Blackwater-River-State-Forest (Krul facilities: 'Restrooms and showers') + ReserveAmerica alerts ('Restrooms with showers are available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Sites are reserved site-specific on the Florida State Forests ReserveAmerica site (or 877-879-3859), from the same day up to 11 months ahead.

booking.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/krul-campground-blackwater-river-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120113 (Booking Window, RV or Tent: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'; Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific) + FDACS page ('For information and reservations, visit FloridaStateForests.ReserveAmerica.com or call 877-879-3859'), read 2026-10-21

note: Florida Forest Service. Swimming dock and pier on spring-fed Krul Lake. No pets. Day passes not valid for camping entry. Separate from Bear Lake (~1.3 mi away).
summary: Confirmed on the FDACS page and the Florida State Forests ReserveAmerica site: 43 sites, all 30/50-amp with water, reservable site-specific 11 months ahead. Changed max_rig_ft 68 -> 90 (the catalog's longest pull-through; lengths 29-90), added pull-throughs, showers, open year-round. policy_ref none is correct (the Forest Service is outside the state:FL park system). Fees left (human-checked 2026-10-12). Note trimmed of the site count/hookups/length range/reservation line the fields now carry.
flags: Missing phone: FDACS gives 877-879-3859 for Blackwater River State Forest camping information and reservations.
